utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-04-74-A, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. I would like to begin by ensuring that the audio equipment is working properly. Can the appellants hear the proceedings in a language they understand. Let me begin with Mr. Prlic. Can you hear me and understand me? THE APPELLANT PRLIC: Yes, Mr. President I'm able to follow you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Stojic. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. Everything is all right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Praljak. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] Your Honours, there are no problems. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Petkovic. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, everything is all right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Petkovic. Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT CORIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Coric. Counsel for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. And for the record my name is Sarah Finnin. I appear on behalf of the Prosecution with Senior Appeals Counsel Laurel Baig, Barbara Goy, and our Case Manager Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Ms. Finnin. I should note that on the 20th of January, 2015, Mr. Pusic filed his consent to hold today's Status Conference in his absence. Before calling for the appearance of the Defence, I note that on 13th of January, 2015, Mr. Prlic filed his waiver of his right to be represented by his counsel and co-counsel during today's Status Conference. Mr. Prlic is confirming the accuracy of that. Let me turn to the other defendants. The defendant for -- council for Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. My name is Senka Nozica. I represent Mr. Stojic, accompanied by Aidan Ellis, legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Nozica. For Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. PINTER
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, your Honour. Good afternoon to everyone. Representing General Praljak, Nika Pinter, attorney-at-law.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Pinter. For Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. Vesna Alaburic representing General Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Alaburic. For Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Drazen Plavec, co-counsel for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Representing Mr. Pusic, Counsel Ibrisimovic, Fahrudin Ibrisimovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Ibrisimovic. Thank you all. As you are aware, Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence requires the Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference has been held for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes: First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions and for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. Second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their case. In the present case, the last Status Conference was held on 23 September 2014. Today's Status Conference was scheduled by order issued on 16 December 2014. I turn to the health of the appellants and let me inquire now into the status of -- the status of the detention conditions and the health situation of the appellants. If any of the appellants wishes, this discussion can take place in a closed session. Anyone who would like me to close the session? I see no desire to close the session, so we will continue with an open session. And let me now go one by one and check whether there are any problems. And, again, let me start with Mr. Prlic. THE APPELLANT PRLIC: Thank you, Mr. President. I have no complaint to make. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Stojic. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour. I have no complaints.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Stojic. Mr. Praljak. I see Mr. Praljak is ready already. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] I don't have any problems Your Honour, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Praljak. Mr. Petkovic. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] No complaints Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Petkovic. Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Coric. Let me now say a few words about the recent procedural history of this case, an update. All the appellants' briefs in this case were filed on 12th January 2014. The Defence and the Prosecution respondents briefs are to be filed no later than 7 May 2015, and the Defence and the Prosecution's and reply briefs are to be filed no later than 29 May 2015. Let me now ask you whether any of the parties have any issues that they would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. No issues to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I see that neither the Defence nor the Prosecution have any issues that they would like to raise. I did not formally hear from the appellants, but I understand that the answer is no. Since there are no other matters to be raised, I thank the parties for their attendance. I thank the interpreters and the Registry, and I adjourn these proceedings.
